judge.reason: Both versions add the same _cached_cond_info helper and route condition-like locks to it. Y also changes the signature to _cached_wrapper(func, cache, key, lock=None, cond=None, info=None). Any existing caller that passes (func, cache, key, lock, info) by position would now put info into cond and leave info as None, so the cache_info path silently stops working. Y also adds a debug print to stdout on every cache miss, which is a behaviour change, and it leaves a dead commented-out block. X is the same logic without these problems, so it is simpler.
